text: Mrs. Li, a former actress losing her looks and her wealthy husband's attention, visits Aunt Mei, a chef whose [special dumplings promise rejuvenation|wants|cheating death and age]. The secret ingredient is unborn fetuses from an abortion clinic in Shenzhen, and when progress is slow Mrs. Li [demands something more potent|wrong|selfish appetites]. [Her beauty returns|rules|the body changes] and her husband desires her again, but at a dinner party her friends notice [a horrid fish-like smell|images|sounds, smells and silence] that comes from Mrs. Li herself.
